short_reason: No trade cleared the bar this week. The strongest buy-low, Chase Brown (71% of Cincinnati's RB opportunities, one touchdown), only pairs with a deal that swaps Jayden Daniels for Bo Nix, a big downgrade at superflex QB on a Denver offense ranked 31st in yards per game. Dak Prescott just posted a QB6 week (three touchdowns vs Philadelphia), so he is no longer cheap. Emeka Egbuka's availability is unclear after a reported concussion and foot injury. Trevor Lawrence has topped 20 points in every game and is on a bye, and Tyler Shough has a Week 8 bye, so selling or buying either now costs a lineup spot for no clear edge. Check back after the Week 8 byes.
